description: This file defines classes and functions related to fixture management and lifecycle in a testing framework, including Fixture, FixtureRunner, and related utility functions.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Represents a test fixture with setup and teardown logic, dependencies, and usage tracking.

classes.name: FixtureRunner
classes.description: Manages fixture instances, their setup and teardown, and parameter resolution for test functions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the fixture, executing its registration function if necessary.

methods.name: _setupInternal
methods.description: Performs internal setup logic, resolving dependencies and invoking the registration function.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Cleans up the fixture, executing teardown logic and removing it from the runner.

methods.name: _teardownInternal
methods.description: Performs internal teardown logic, resolving dependencies and cleaning up usage references.

methods.name: _collectFixturesInTeardownOrder
methods.description: Recursively collects fixtures in the order needed for teardown based on dependencies.
